subject: Incremental seat conversion & pricing options for mid-contract uplift
messages:
From: Sara Patel <sara.patel@lyrica.ai>
To: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai>
Cc: Procurement <procurement@lyrica.ai>, Alex Romero <alex.romero@lyrica.ai>
Date: Mon, 31 Aug 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Mid-contract seat conversion and uplift — data & ask

Hi Stephanie,

Thanks again for the demo last month — the team found the latency and cost benchmarks compelling. We have an internal ask that came up this morning: due to an accelerated hiring phase we're looking at converting a block of our reserved seats into on-demand/consumption for the next 6 months and adding ~2,000 incremental seats as a short-term top-up. Our renewal isn't until 2026-11-12, so this would be a mid-contract change.

Can Redwood outline:
- Options for converting reserved seats to consumption mid-contract (one-time swap vs staged conversion).
- Pricing for a 2,000-seat short-term top-up (Aug–Dec) and how credits/overage would be handled.
- Any co-term / annualization paths if we want to fold the top-up into the Nov renewal.

I've attached our Q2 usage report for context (we're averaging 12M tokens/day and expect a 25% increase with the hires). Procurement on copy — they prefer a concise options list we can share with finance.

Appreciate a quick sketch — happy to book a 30-min call if needed.

Best,
Sara
Sara Patel
Director, Infrastructure
Lyrica AI

Attachments: usage_report_Q2.csv (csv)
From: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai>
To: Sara Patel <sara.patel@lyrica.ai>
Cc: Procurement <procurement@lyrica.ai>, Alex Romero <alex.romero@lyrica.ai>
Date: Mon, 31 Aug 2026 11:04:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Mid-contract seat conversion and uplift — data & ask

Hi Sara — thanks for the report, that helps. Quick read and a few high-level options that align with your timelines:

1) One-time top-up (short-term, Aug–Dec):
   - Add 2,000 seats as a temporary reserved/top-up SKU at a blended rate (list - 18%). Billing prorated by days used; unused committed units can be converted to credits toward Nov renewal if you opt in.

2) Staged conversion (recommended if usage is spiky):
   - Convert up to X reserved seats to consumption in 2 waves (30% now / 70% Nov) with a 10% conversion fee on the swapped capacity. This preserves some committed discount while giving flexibility.

3) Co-term + annualize (if you plan to keep the capacity):
   - Annualize the top-up at renewal with a 12-month commitment; we can offer a 15% uplift discount versus short-term top-up pricing and a one-time onboarding credit to offset pro-rated charges.

I attached a short staccato doc that lays out the mechanics and quick math examples so procurement can share with finance. If you prefer, I can put Ben and Lauren on a 30-min call tomorrow to run numbers and show the margin/discount trade-offs.

Next steps (proposed):
- You confirm preferred path (one-time top-up / staged / co-term).
- We run a short pricing model and return a formal offer + DocuSign for procurement.

If helpful, suggested times for a call: Tue 10:00–11:00 PT or Wed 14:00–15:00 PT.

Thanks —
Stephanie Nguyen
Sr. Account Executive | Redwood Inference
stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai

Attachments: conversion_options.pdf (pdf)
From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
To: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 1 Sep 2026 08:22:00 -07:00
Subject: Internal: pricing sketch for Lyrica DL-2891

Stephanie — quick internal calc after looking at Sara's usage file and the three paths you suggested. High-level assumptions: 2,000 seats = peak delta ~25% on current throughput, expected token growth through Dec ~25%.

Proposals:
- One-time top-up price: list $0.045/seat-hour => blended at 18% off => $0.0369/seat-hour. Estimated monthly delta ~$46k (Aug–Dec), total gross uplift ~$230k.
- Staged conversion: 10% conversion fee on swapped reserved units + consumption price at 10% premium vs co-term.
- Co-term annualize: 15% discount on annualized commitment, plus a $10k onboarding credit to offset pro-rated charges.

Margin note: one-time top-up at 18% discount yields low margin in our model if they return to high usage; co-term annualize preserves margin. If we want to be competitive, recommend tying discount to a 9–12 month partial commitment or a usage trigger (e.g., >15M tokens/day).

Also recommend offering an SLA tweak: availability guarantee at 99.9% for commit tiers >X with a performance credit (0.5% monthly credit capped at 10% of monthly charge) — helps procurement justify the rate.

I've attached the calc workbook. If you want to present a single consolidated offer to Lyrica, I can clean numbers and produce the PDF offer (redwood_offer_DL-2891.pdf).

Ben
Ben Carter
Director, Strategic Sales Operations

Attachments: pricing_model_calc.xlsx (xlsx)
From: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai>
To: Sara Patel <sara.patel@lyrica.ai>, Procurement <procurement@lyrica.ai>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 2 Sep 2026 15:43:00 -07:00
Subject: RE: Mid-contract seat conversion and uplift — data & ask

Sara — following internal alignment, here's a concise offer we can put on DocuSign once you confirm path. Happy to finalize on a short call but wanted to give procurement something to review this afternoon.

Option A — Temporary top-up (Aug 31–Dec 31):
- 2,000-seat top-up as reserved-topup SKU at blended rate $0.0369/seat-hour (18% off list).
- Prorated billing; unused committed units convert to a one-time credit applicable at renewal.
- No conversion fee.
- Estimated incremental spend Aug–Dec: $230,000.

Option B — Staged conversion (30% now / 70% at renewal):
- Convert 30% of nominated reserved seats to consumption immediately; remaining 70% converted as part of Nov co-term.
- Conversion fee: 10% on swapped reserved capacity (one-time).
- Consumption price during interim: $0.041/seat-hour.

Option C — Annualize (co-term at renewal):
- Annualize the 2,000-seat uplift into a 12-month commitment starting at renewal.
- Discount: 15% off list for the annualized volume + $10,000 onboarding credit.
- SLA addendum: 99.9% availability with performance credit schedule (on request).

Required next steps:
1) Tell us which option you prefer (A/B/C) or request a call to walk the math.
2) If Option A or B, confirm exact seat mapping (which reserved SKUs to top-up / swap).
3) Procurement: if you want the co-term path (Option C), we will prepare the annualized amendment and DocuSign link (see provisional link below).

Provisional DocuSign: https://www.docusign.com/sign?docId=DL-2891-offer (will be refreshed once you confirm).

If you want a single-sheet comparison for finance, I can send a one-pager with the estimated monthly cashflow and net present value comparison.

Thanks —
Stephanie Nguyen
Sr. Account Executive | Redwood Inference
stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai
